name: TAF Monthly Eligibility File
description: The TAF Monthly Eligibility file contains monthly eligibility records for individuals enrolled in Medicaid or CHIP. Each record captures a beneficiary's eligibility status, enrollment group, managed care participation, and dual Medicare/Medicaid enrollment status for a given month within the reference year.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: TAF Monthly Eligibility Records
description: Monthly eligibility records from the CMS T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF). Each row represents a beneficiary's enrollment status for a given calendar month, capturing eligibility group, managed care enrollment, dual eligibility, and coverage details. Multiple rows per beneficiary per year (one per month enrolled).

content.msis_ident_num: String: Medicaid system identifier number assigned by the state
content.year: Int32: Reference year of the eligibility record
content.mon: Int32: Calendar month of the eligibility record (1=January, 12=December)
content.elgblty_grp_cd: String: Eligibility group code indicating the basis of Medicaid/CHIP eligibility (e.g., SSI-related, poverty-related, CHIP)
content.dual_elgbl_cd: String: Dual eligibility code indicating Medicare and Medicaid enrollment status (e.g., 01=QMB only, 02=QMB+full Medicaid, 06=Full dual)
content.chip_cd: String: CHIP indicator code (1=Medicaid expansion CHIP, 2=Separate CHIP, 0=Not CHIP)
content.mc_plan_type_cd_1: String: Managed care plan type code for first plan enrollment
content.mc_plan_id_1: String: Managed care plan identifier for first plan enrollment
content.mc_plan_type_cd_2: String: Managed care plan type code for second plan enrollment
content.mc_plan_id_2: String: Managed care plan identifier for second plan enrollment
content.age_num: Int32: Age of beneficiary as of the first day of the reference month
content.sex_cd: String: Sex of the beneficiary (M = Male, F = Female, U = Unknown)
content.zip_cd: String: 5-digit ZIP code of beneficiary residence
content.cnty_cd: String: County FIPS code of beneficiary residence
content.ssdi_ind: Int32: Supplemental Security Disability Insurance indicator (1 = receiving SSDI, 0 = not)
content.ssi_ind: Int32: Supplemental Security Income indicator (1 = receiving SSI, 0 = not)
content.foster_care_ind: Int32: Foster care indicator (1 = foster care enrollee, 0 = not)
content.prmry_lang_cd: String: Primary language code for the beneficiary
